state.background: Phase 6 batch B08 transfers exactly three Plan45 stable IDs to Browser Mode: p45-b-real-consumption-99-page-tsx-e2e-real-consumption-chart-with-actual-browser (#99), p45-b-real-consumption-128-page-tsx-e2e-real-consumption-chart-with-actual-browser (#128), and p45-b-real-consumption-156-page-tsx-e2e-real-consumption-chart-with-actual-browser (#156). The Browser Mode route tests preserve the source fixture's __MOUNT_ALL__ behavior. Exact source contracts: #99 checks the first page-global [aria-pressed] control is visible, attempts a click with a 5-second timeout while swallowing click failure, then waits 500ms; the source does not assert chart change, and Browser Mode does not claim one. #128 scrolls the real section into view, checks visibility within 15 seconds, checks the summary is visible, and accepts either zero local legend items or all local legend items hidden; it does not explicitly assert details.open. #156 checks section visibility within 15 seconds, clicks the summary, and checks the first section-local legend item becomes visible. Independent implementation and post-cutover source audits passed. Focused Browser Mode passed 3/3; the residual E2E suite completed build/type-check and passed 15 with 18 skipped. Starting from B07 M=108, this batch advances M to 111; 21 of 33 eligible Phase 6 scenarios are accepted and 12 remain Playwright-owned. #174 remains in Playwright for B09.
acceptanceCriteria: All three B08 stable IDs preserve their exact mapped source assertions in permanent fail-on-contract Browser Mode tests, including the source fixture behavior.
#99 checks visibility of the first page-global [aria-pressed] control, reproduces the swallowed 5-second click attempt and 500ms wait, and does not claim that chart data changes.
#128 checks section and summary visibility and preserves the source's empty-list-or-all-hidden local legend assertion; it does not add or claim a details.open assertion.
#156 checks visible section, clicks its summary, and verifies the first local legend item becomes visible.
Only these three mapped E2E scenarios were cut over; #174 remains Playwright-owned for B09.
The focused production Browser Mode suite and post-cutover residual E2E suite pass, and independent implementation/source-boundary audits support the cutover.
The cumulative ledger advances from A=123/E=123/M=108 to A=123/E=123/M=111, with 21 accepted and 12 pending out of 33.
verification: Focused run `pnpm run test:browser:phase6-b08:built` passed one file / three tests. Durable log: results/plan45/phase6/phase6-b08-browser-mode-validation-2026-09-27.log.

After source cutover, residual `pnpm test:e2e:fresh` completed build/type-check and passed 15 tests with 18 skipped and zero failures. Durable log: results/plan45/phase6/phase6-b08-residual-e2e-validation-2026-09-27.log.
Independent implementation and post-cutover source-boundary audits passed.
knownConstraints: This checkpoint covers B08 only. B09-B13 remain pending and are not included in M.
#99 intentionally preserves a best-effort click whose failure is swallowed; neither the source nor the Browser Mode test asserts a chart-change outcome.
#128 intentionally does not assert details.open; the source contract is limited to section/summary visibility and local legend visibility state.
state.outputRequirement: Choose exactly one criterion for this implementation checkpoint. If the initial choice is not valid_as_defined, follow exactly one required case-specific clarification and preserve the initial result; do not turn a non-pass into a pass.

implementation.instructions: Evaluate whether B08 is a valid full cutover under the acceptance criteria and evidence. Select the single best matching criterion.

criteria.valid_as_defined: The supplied source-contract, cutover, ledger, and verification evidence supports accepting B08 as defined.
criteria.requirements_mismatch: A concrete conflict exists between requirements and implementation or recorded evidence; identify the requirement and requirement-only correction.
criteria.missing_prerequisites_info: Required prerequisite information is missing; identify exactly what is needed.
criteria.incomplete_implementation_info: Specific evidence needed to assess B08 is missing; identify the exact gap.
criteria.implementation_issue: A concrete implementation or reporting defect violates a criterion; name the location, evidence, and implementation-only correction.
criteria.scope_violation: The cutover exceeds or falls outside the agreed batch boundary; identify the boundary and adjustment.
